thread:
lily: heads-up — pairing the pricing page AB with next week's webinar landing page. want to sync the calculator CTA language + routing so webinar registrants who 'estimate cost & chat' get routed to SDRs for quick follow-up.
mark: OK. two CTA variants? 'Calculate' (no form) vs 'Estimate & request a chat' (collect contact). we should test which drives webinar-to-demo conversion.
sean: from product: also test including a short benchmarking blurb under each tier: "latency-optimized" vs "throughput-optimized" and include a one-line cost example for 1M tokens. clarity beats clever names.
priya: copy idea: use outcome-first labels but keep a small parenthetical with current numeric tiers for existing customers. helps avoid confusion.
tom: ops note: if the calculator collects contact info we'll need routing rules: webinar leads -> SDR queue A, pricing-calc leads -> SDR queue B. add `interest: webinar` or `interest: pricing_calc` flag in payload.
amanda: design: inline calc should be collapsible on mobile and have the two CTA toggles. will attach mocks in Drive.
analytics-bot: events created: `pricing_calc.view`, `pricing_calc.submit`, `pricing_calc.contact_opt_in`, `webinar_reg.from_pricing`. funnels: `pricing_calc -> demo_request`, `pricing_page_view -> webinar_reg`.
lily: sample minimal payload for devs (send with `pricing_ab_may` utm): ```{"monthly_tokens":"1000000","selected_tier":"throughput","contact_opt_in":true,"interest":"webinar"}```
sean: good. also we should add a microcopy line in FAQ: "How do I estimate cost?" link to calc + explain rounding/assumptions.
priya: question: webinar narrative — should we surface the benchmark comparison vs other hosts on pricing page? legal might flag. propose we add a neutral 'industry benchmarks' CTA in the webinar content instead of pricing page.
tom: agreed. keep price page focused on self-serve cost estimation and routing. benchmarks in webinar slide deck + blog post.
mark: launch plan: 1) implement calc + contact flow, 2) AB test CTA text, 3) run for 2 weeks, 4) review webinar registrant->demo conversion. i'll set flags in LaunchDarkly: `pricing_ab_may_calc`, `pricing_ab_may_cta`.
analytics-bot: experiment ids: `exp_pricing_may_calc_v1`, `exp_pricing_may_cta_v2` created. monitoring dashboard: /dashboards/pricing_ab_may (will populate after events).
lily: can everyone freeze copy and CTA variants by EOD? want dev to have assets tomorrow morning.
amanda: yea i'll upload final assets in an hour.
sean: i'll prep the FAQ reorder and microcopy.
lily: thanks team. quick follow-up tomorrow 9:30 PT for smoke check after deploy. :rocket:
